description:
Twenty trials of our framework under truncated credit, to measure what the two frameworks are worth when each is allowed to be tuned rather than made to wear the other's settings.
The comparison this belongs to: our kernel under exact credit found 1034.13, and running that point on upstream's implementation returned 324.90 while running it on our own truncated credit returned 270.88. That pair says the gap is the credit rather than the framework, but it says it at one point that was chosen under exact credit, and both truncated runs sat on the collapse floor where nothing is distinguishable. So each framework is searched over the same space, from the same opening four points, and compared at its own best.
Everything outside the six searched dimensions is pinned to what the recorded 1043.66 run used, the seed is fixed, and credit is pinned to tbptt, so this differs from the search that found 1034.13 in exactly one parameter. Twenty TPE trials over six dimensions is not a converged search; what it produces is a fair-ish ceiling, not a tuned setting.
name: search-tbptt
